tools.name: list_llm_prices
tools.description: Current list prices (USD per 1M tokens: input, cached input, output) for OpenAI, Anthropic and Google models, with announced price changes. Use it to find a model id or to compare prices.

tools.name: get_llm_price
tools.description: Current list price of one model by id, e.g. "gpt-4o-mini" or "claude-sonnet-4-5". Includes the long-context rate and any announced change.

tools.name: estimate_llm_cost
tools.description: USD cost of a call to a model from its token counts, at list price, and the total for a number of such calls.

tools.name: compare_llm_costs
tools.description: USD cost of the same call (same token counts) on each of several models, cheapest first. Use it to pick a model or to price a switch.

tools.name: subscription_break_even
tools.description: How many AI messages a month a subscriber can send before the model cost uses up what the plan earns, after the store or payment fee. Answers: does this plan price cover this model?

tools.name: fiscallm_setup_guide
tools.description: What FiscaLLM is and the ways to send it AI usage (OpenTelemetry, LiteLLM, SDK, HTTP), connect revenue, and read margins back.

tools.name: get_margin_overview
tools.description: The app's AI cost, revenue, margin, share of revenue spent on AI, request count and daily series over a period. Needs the app's key.

tools.name: list_users_by_margin
tools.description: Each user's AI cost, revenue and margin over a period, the users losing the most money first. Needs the app's key.

tools.name: get_plan_margins
tools.description: AI cost, revenue and margin of each plan or product over a period. Needs the app's key.

tools.name: get_cost_breakdown
tools.description: The app's AI cost over a period split by model and by feature. Needs the app's key.
